_about: Trams and metropolitan buses (engine/fetch_surface.py, engine/surface.py), from Transport Victoria's GTFS Schedule, which ships one zip per mode inside one zip ('inner': 3 metropolitan trams, 4 metropolitan buses; merged into one feed). The map draws trams from its own coloured layer (transit.py), so streetcars.geojson isn't used by the map; the trams are fetched so the card's Transit nearby can list them. Tram and bus numbers don't collide (trams 1-109, buses 200 up). Night Network buses run Friday and Saturday nights only, so the weeknight 'overnight' family has none; they show as Regular. Regional buses (folder 5/6) and V/Line coaches are left out.
